name: a rock

VINIT.justification: the undifferentiated molten state before mineral crystallization

TANCH.justification: the final bounded object containing the geological history

AFWD.justification: the forward transformation from liquid to solid phase

AREV.justification: the reverse transformation from solid back to sediment or solution

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of pressure and heat to form rock

IMSCRIB.justification: the specific chemical composition that defines the rock as itself

FSPLIT.justification: the force that splits a single mass into compression and tension zones

FFUSE.justification: the reconstitution of the mass into a single stable geological unit

EVALT.justification: the affirmative state of a solid cohesive rock

EVALF.justification: the negative state of structural failure or discontinuity

ENGAGR.justification: the simultaneous state of being solid yet flowing under extreme heat and pressure

IFIX.justification: the permanent irreversible record of biological or geological events within the stone

phase_3.void_description: the pre-geological state of unorganized matter
phase_3.both_description: the plastic state of rock at the mantle boundary

steps.domain_action: the emergence of molten silicate melt
the cooling process initiates phase transition
the specific mineral species identifies its lattice
the bonding of atoms into a repeating geometric structure
the application of differential tectonic pressure
the rock maintains cohesion under compressive force
the rock develops a fault line under tensile force
the rock undergoes ductile deformation without breaking
the surface layers undergo chemical decomposition
the internal and external forces reach a static balance
the inclusion of a trace element or fossil records a specific moment in time
the rock achieves its final form as a distinct geological object

phase_5.ipc_mechanism: phonon propagation through the crystalline lattice
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: geological time scales and tectonic cycles

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the local entropy decrease in the rock is balanced by heat release to the environment
